fp.write_text('def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 seqs=[]
 for r in (grid[0], grid[-1]):
  c=0
  while c<w:
   if r[c]==0: c+=1; continue
   seq=[]
   while c<w and r[c]!=0: seq.append(r[c]); c+=1
   seqs.append(seq)
 for r,row in enumerate(grid):
  if r in (0,h-1): continue
  for c,v in enumerate(row):
   if not v: continue
   for seq in seqs:
    if v in seq:
     start=c-seq.index(v)
     for j,x in enumerate(seq):
      if 0<=start+j<w: out[r][start+j]=x
     break
 return out
')
